description: ACCDB: DAO Recordset2.AbsolutePosition across mutations (mutable): (1) own Delete (middle & last row) -> get (-1) & put; (2) sibling Delete via Clone: mid-row deleted by clone, LAST populated row deleted by clone (closes NotModelled.AbsolutePositionDeletedLastRow), and failed Bookmark put after sibling deleted remembered anchor (closes NotModelled.AbsolutePositionBookmarkInvalidDeletedRow); (3) AbsolutePosition put during pending Edit and pending AddNew; (4) AbsolutePosition after AddNew+Update and Bookmark=LastModified. Keeps all pages before/after writes and Close.

args.text: SELECT ID, N FROM Items ORDER BY ID
